spec_match.rationale: The pills and annotated code now report rule match state read back from the rendered card (getComputedStyle flexDirection / borderColor) rather than a JS re-implementation of the width math, so what the page claims matches what the browser actually did.

interactive.rationale: A width slider and three preset buttons (keyboard/touch operable) drive the container alongside the CSS resize corner, all feeding one ResizeObserver that re-reads computed styles.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a resize playground with live status; the status is now observed truth and the live code block annotates clause arithmetic versus rendered result, flagging any divergence.

edge_cases.rationale: A CSSOM capability note explains when the comma rule is dropped (Chromium ≤149), and the code block prints a NOTE when predicted and observed diverge — exactly the pre-150 case.

conformance.rationale: Aligned with the feature suite; the observed-truth telemetry assertion mirrors the parse contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): support note shown; pill 2 honestly reads 'rule not parsed here' (previously it falsely said APPLYING); after the 560px preset pill 1 reads 'rendered row' from computed styles; the live code block shows the active width; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read.

telemetry_health.rationale: multi-condition-observed-truth assertion holds (no false-positive rule-2 firing where the comma rule was dropped).

design_system.rationale: Pills use the firing/idle pattern at AA; preset buttons reuse the match-pill style.

accessibility.rationale: Added a labelled width slider and preset buttons (44px) so the width axis is operable without the drag corner; the readout pills carry text state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: The CSS resize corner is not keyboard/touch operable; provide a slider or preset-width buttons wired to the same state.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Derive demonstrated state from computed styles, not from re-implemented breakpoint math.

summary: Fixed (goal-setting pass): rule state is read from the rendered card instead of width arithmetic (ending the false 'APPLYING' readout), and a keyboard/touch width control plus a capability note were added.
